headline: Inventory up 15% YoY nationally; 31 of 50 metros have more price cuts than a year ago.

brief.text: Active inventory is up 15% from a year ago, the fastest build in listings since the data series began to normalize after 2022. The national median sale price is down 1.8% YoY at $422,200, so prices are roughly flat in real terms. 31 of the 50 tracked metros now have a larger share of listings with price cuts than a year ago, concentrated in Florida and Texas. The 30-year mortgage rate eased to 6.18% from 6.70% a year ago, which trims the typical payment. Midwest and Northeast metros remain the most competitive, with homes still selling near or above list price.
key_points: 31 of 50 metros have more price cuts than last year
